Nicotine Nirvana — WooCommerce Migration Proposal

Client: Nicotine Nirvana (nicotinenirvana.com), e-liquid, pod kits and disposable e-cigs
Prepared by: LitOS/LitGroup  ·  Date: October 9, 2026
$1,350Total estimate (§5)
45h$30/hrMigration build + improvements
BlocksyFree theme (§4)

You asked us to rebuild your Volusion store on WooCommerce with the same look and content. While reviewing the current site we noted a few things that cost you sales or look broken, mostly on mobile. This document lists what we'd fix during the move, the plugins we'd set up, and the cost.

1

What we found and what we'd improve

AreaWhat we see todayWhat we'd do
Category tilesTiles and labels sit at different heights (§1.1)Equal tile sizes, labels on one line
Product cardsAdd to cart is only on the product page (§1.2)Equal-height cards with the buy button on the card
Text spacingText touches the page edge (§1.3)Consistent padding on all pages
Shop sidebarSite links, no filters (§1.4)Filters first: brand, category, price, stock
Free shipping infoOpens a small separate browser window (§1.5)In-page popup or toggle
Mobile layoutText cut off on the left (§1.6)Responsive build, tested on phone widths
Mobile menuOpens but can't be closed (§1.7)Menu with a visible close button
Back-in-stockShows on products that are in stock (§1.8)Show only when the selected option is out of stock

1.1 Category tiles

TodayLook at the red box. The two tiles have different image heights, so the labels and arrows don't line up. We'd make the tiles the same size so labels sit on one line.

1.2 Product cards

Today the customer has to open each product to buy. We'd put the buy button on the card, and make every card the same height: names limited to two lines, price and button always at the bottom. We recommend showing the button all the time rather than on hover, because phones have no hover. If you prefer hover on desktop, we can do that.

ReferenceExample from another store. We'd take the stock line ("In stock · ships in 1 business day") and the full-width button. "Notify me" appears on the out-of-stock product.

ReferenceExample from another store. Names are cut at two lines, so prices and buttons line up across the row. Same idea we'd use for your cards.

1.3 Text spacing

TodayLook at the red boxes. Testimonials and the legal text start right at the edge with no padding. We'd set one padding rule for all content pages.

1.4 Shop sidebar

The sidebar is the place where shoppers narrow down a large catalog. Today it holds site links only. We'd put filters at the top and move the site links below them, or into the menu and footer, as you prefer.

TodayThe red box shows the current sidebar: Deals & Discounts, E-Cig 101, E-Cig FAQ, Shipping, Warranty & Returns and more.

New filters: brand, category, price, and in stock / out of stock.

1.5 Free shipping information

TodayClicking "Free USPS shipping on orders $60+" opens a separate small window. On a phone this takes the customer out of the page.

We'd open the same text in a popup on the page. A toggle is the other option.

ReferenceToggle style from another store. The text opens under the row and nothing leaves the page. We'd use it for the Shipping & Return details.

1.6 Mobile layout

TodayTested at 412 × 924. The first letters of many lines are cut off on the Testimonials page and in the age notice. We'd build the pages responsive and check them at phone widths.

1.7 Mobile menu

TodayThe menu opens over the page and covers the warning banner, but there's no close button. We'd use the Blocksy off-canvas menu with a close button and tap-outside to close.

1.8 Back-in-stock button

TodayThe red box shows "Email me when Back-In-Stock" under an in-stock product with "Add To Cart" active. We'd show it only when the selected option is out of stock. This product has a nicotine-strength option, so we'd check every option.

3

Open questions

#QuestionWhy it matters
1Roughly how many products, customers and orders do you have?It sets the LitExtension plan you buy and the time for checking the data.
2How are brands stored in Volusion today?The brand filter (§1.4) needs a clean brand field on each product.
3Free shipping info: popup or toggle?Both are in the 45h. We need one to build.
4Buy button on cards: always visible, or on hover on desktop?We recommend always visible (§1.2).
5Do you want the age warning banner and the 21+ notice kept as they are?We copy both unless you want changes.
6Which payment provider will you use, and where will the site be hosted?Not all providers accept this product category. Hosting is a separate cost (§5).
4

Theme

We recommend Blocksy, a free theme from wordpress.org. It works with WooCommerce, is light and fast, and has a built-in mobile off-canvas menu (§1.7). We'd set up your brand colours, logo and layout on it. Any other theme you prefer is fine, and we'd quote again if it changes the build.
